courses.title: Advanced Computing Team Project
courses.subject: COMP
courses.requisiteNote: To enrol in this course you must meet the eligibility criteria, which includes membership of a student project group before the end of week 1, where the project has been approved by the convener. courses.title: Computing Internship
courses.subject: COMP
courses.requisiteNote: To enrol in this course you must: Be enrolled in the Master of Computing (MCOMP) and have successfully completed: COMP8260 and COMP6442 OR Be enrolled in the Master of Machine Learning and Computer Vision (MMLCV) and have successfully completed: COMP6710 and (COMP6250 OR COMP8260). Incompatible with COMP8715 and COMP8755 and COMP8800. You will need to undergo competitive entry to enrol in this course.
